title: Grouped, alphabetical CLI help
goal: `nerv help` is grouped by theme, sorted and aligned; `nerv help COMMAND` gives full usage
acceptance: A test fails when a dispatched command is missing from help or help lists one the CLI does not handle
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: one module, its wiring and a test. Not a measurement.
